channel.title: 0xelitesystem new repos
channel.description: New open-source tools and references from 0xelitesystem. All MIT, all self-contained.

item.title: sql-joins-reference

item.description: A plain-language reference on GraphQL: a query language for APIs where the client asks for exactly the fields it wants from a single endpoint. It covers the schema and type system, the difference between queries, mutations, and subscriptions, how ...

item.title: cors-basics-reference
item.description: A plain-language reference for CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing), the browser mechanism that controls when JavaScript on one origin may read responses from another origin. It covers what an origin is, how requests are categorized, the exact HTT...

item.title: conventional-commits-reference
item.description: Conventional Commits is a lightweight convention for writing commit messages in a structured, machine-readable way. It defines a small set of rules for the first line of a commit so that both people and tooling can understand what changed. This re...

item.title: regex-cheatsheet-playground
item.description: A regex cheatsheet, a live tester with match highlighting, and a library of common tested patterns, in one page. No server, no tracking, no third-party scripts.

item.title: css-grid-generator
item.description: A visual CSS Grid builder. Set columns, rows, track sizes, and gaps, preview the grid live, name a few areas, and copy the generated CSS. No server, no tracking, no third-party scripts.

item.title: tokenizer-visualizer
item.description: See approximate token boundaries in any text, color-coded, with a live token and character count. No server, no tracking, no third-party scripts.

item.title: prompt-template-linter
item.description: Paste a prompt template and get a local report: unfilled variables, an approximate token and length estimate, flagged prompt-injection patterns, and simple quality checks. No server, no tracking, no third-party scripts.

item.title: json-schema-to-tool-definition
item.description: Paste a JSON Schema and generate a function/tool-calling definition in both the OpenAI function-calling format and the Anthropic tool format. No server, no tracking, no third-party scripts.

item.title: chatml-message-builder
item.description: Visually build a chat messages array and export it in OpenAI-style and Anthropic-style JSON. No server, no tracking, no third-party scripts.

item.title: htaccess-redirect-generator
item.description: Build Apache `.htaccess` redirect and rewrite rules in your browser. No server, no tracking, no third-party scripts.

item.title: lorem-ipsum-generator
item.description: Generate lorem ipsum placeholder text in your browser. No server, no tracking, no third-party scripts.

item.title: mock-data-generator
item.description: Generate fake test data in your browser. No server, no tracking, no third-party scripts.

item.title: gzip-size-estimator
item.description: Paste text or code and see its raw byte size versus gzip and deflate compressed size, right in your browser. No server, no tracking, no third-party scripts.

item.title: color-blindness-simulator
item.description: Preview how an image or a set of colors reads under common color-vision deficiencies, all in your browser. No server, no tracking, no third-party scripts.

item.title: color-palette-from-image
item.description: Extract a dominant color palette from any image, right in your browser. No server, no tracking, no third-party scripts.

item.description: Compute a CSS `clamp()` for fluid typography and spacing from a min and max viewport and size, with correct `vw`-based linear interpolation and the math explained. No server, no tracking, no third-party scripts.

item.title: cubic-bezier-editor

item.title: json-path-tester

item.title: user-agent-parser
item.description: Break a User-Agent string into browser, engine, operating system, and device type. No server, no tracking, no third-party scripts.

item.title: sql-formatter
item.description: Pretty-print and minify SQL in your browser. No server, no tracking, no third-party scripts.

item.title: box-shadow-generator
item.description: Visual CSS box-shadow builder with live preview, stacked layers, inset support, and copy-ready output.

item.title: gradient-generator
item.description: Build CSS linear, radial, and conic gradients with a live preview and one-click copy.

item.title: svg-optimizer
item.description: Strip and minify SVG markup in your browser: no upload, no network, nothing leaves your machine.

item.title: image-to-data-uri
item.description: Convert any image into a base64 data URI you can paste straight into HTML, CSS, or Markdown.

item.title: favicon-generator
item.description: Make a favicon from text, an emoji, or an uploaded image, right in your browser.

item.title: image-compressor
item.description: Compress and resize images in your browser. Fully local, no upload, no account.

item.title: timezone-converter
item.description: A single-file world clock and meeting planner. Track the current time across any set of zones, then pick a moment to see it everywhere at once and find the working-hours overlap for a call.

item.title: duration-calculator
item.description: Exact time between two dates, business day counts with holiday exclusions, and add or subtract durations from any date, all in a single HTML file.

item.title: curl-to-fetch
item.description: Paste a curl command and get JavaScript fetch and Python requests code, generated entirely in your browser.

item.title: hash-generator

item.title: xml-formatter
item.description: Format, minify, and validate XML in your browser. One HTML file, no network, nothing leaves your machine.

item.title: markdown-table-generator
